SELECT r.id as role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.menu_check_strictly, r.dept_check_strictly, r.status, r.is_system, r.description, r.remark, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.create_by, r.update_by, r.is_deleted, r.delete_time FROM sys_role r WHERE r.is_deleted = 0
AND r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roleName}, '%')
AND r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roleCode}, '%')
AND r.role_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{roleKey}, '%')
AND r.status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.role_sort ASC, r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id as role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.menu_check_strictly, r.dept_check_strictly, r.status, r.is_system, r.description, r.remark, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.create_by, r.update_by, r.is_deleted, r.delete_time FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.role_sort ASC

SELECT r.id as role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.menu_check_strictly, r.dept_check_strictly, r.status, r.is_system, r.description, r.remark, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.create_by, r.update_by, r.is_deleted, r.delete_time FROM sys_role r WHERE r.id = #{roleId} AND r.is_deleted = 0

SELECT r.id as role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.menu_check_strictly, r.dept_check_strictly, r.status, r.is_system, r.description, r.remark, r.create_time, r.update_time, r.create_by, r.update_by, r.is_deleted, r.delete_time FROM sys_role r INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON r.id = rm.role_id WHERE r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND rm.menu_id = #{menuId} ORDER BY r.role_sort ASC
